frozen_rules.extraction: dpkg-deb -x into a fresh /tmp dir; member enumeration via find; no execution of package binaries, scripts, or maintainer scripts
frozen_rules.extension_rule: case-insensitive suffix match; files under deb control archive excluded (data.tar.xz payload only)

keyword_scan.applies_to: members whose first 2000 bytes are >=85% printable (decodable as utf-8 or gbk)

comparison_targets.incon.dat: vs official-gbbq.zip!zhb.zip!incon.dat — byte equality + per-section row counts + coverage of tdxhy.cfg field-2 (T) and field-5 (X) code sets
comparison_targets.rule: absent -> recorded ABSENT_IN_PACKAGE; present -> sha256 + byte-equality vs gen-2 archive member

frozen_rules.manual_scan: keyword_scan over tdxw-left.html corpus; matching lines classified business-level prose unless they name a binary member+field
frozen_rules.binding_test: a finding counts as a semantic anchor ONLY if official text names a binary member/record field AND its business meaning/unit/encoding; keyword presence or business-level capability prose = BUSINESS_LEVEL_ONLY; same-name file presence = MEMBER_CORROBORATION (client uses the file, proves nothing about semantics)

status_taxonomy.FOUND_SEMANTIC_ANCHOR: official text binds a binary member/field to business meaning
status_taxonomy.FOUND_BUSINESS_LEVEL_ONLY: official prose confirms a business capability/concept, no binary binding
status_taxonomy.FOUND_MEMBER_CORROBORATION: client package ships a same-name data file (byte-identical or same-namespace)
status_taxonomy.ABSENT_IN_PACKAGE: comparison target not shipped in the package
status_taxonomy.NOT_FOUND: searched, no such evidence exists in the package
status_taxonomy.NOT_RUN: infeasible on this box (recorded with reason)

prohibited: no disassembly/decompilation/strings-extraction on executables or shared objects
